about.title: About TORSA Consulting
about.subtitle: Your Technology Journey Partner
about.body: TORSA Consulting is a technology advisory, transformation and delivery firm that helps organizations use technology with greater clarity, confidence and purpose.
about.supportingBody: We work with executives, boards, technology leaders and delivery teams to connect business ambition with practical technology outcomes. We help clients shape strategy, establish governance, design solutions, lead implementation, build internal capability and deliver sustainable improvement.
about.whatWeBelieve: Technology has the greatest impact when it is connected to business priorities, owned by capable people and supported by practical governance.
about.beliefBody: TORSA helps organisations make confident technology investments, translate strategy into effective delivery, and build the capability needed to sustain long-term success. We bring together strategic thinking and hands-on delivery to help clients move from complexity to clear, measurable progress.

experience.body: Since its founding in the year 2008, TORSA Consulting has built a strong record of technology advisory, transformation leadership and solution delivery for its clients.
experience.leadership: TORSA is founder-led by Vimal Sharma, a technology transformation leader with more than 25 years of experience across enterprise technology, digital transformation, information security, governance, Agile delivery, service management, product development and technology leadership.
experience.sectors: TORSA’s experience has been built through executive advisory, consulting, program leadership and solution delivery across financial services, telecommunications, insurance, infrastructure, education, engineering and public-sector environments.
experience.work: Our work includes technology carve-outs, independent ICT operating-model establishment, enterprise architecture, cloud and Microsoft 365 transformation, ISO 27001 readiness, GRC digitization, Lean-Agile transformation, IT service management and bespoke software product development.

about.commitment: TORSA is committed to delivering technology outcomes that are practical, secure, scalable and aligned to the client’s real operating environment.
about.successDefinition: We measure success by more than a completed project. Success means clearer leadership decisions, stronger governance, capable teams, improved services and technology that enables the organization to move forward.

services.title: Technology Strategy and Transformation Advisory
services.headline: Turn technology ambition into a practical plan
services.body: Technology should enable growth, resilience and better decisions. TORSA helps executive teams translate business priorities into clear technology strategy, target operating models and delivery roadmaps.
services.supportingBody: We bring independent senior-level perspective, hands-on transformation experience and practical delivery discipline to complex technology decisions.
whatWeDo: Enterprise architecture and target-state technology blueprints
Technology due diligence and program recovery
services.outcome: A clear technology direction, aligned leadership, prioritized investments and a realistic route from strategy to execution.
services.cta: Contact Us to start with a Technology Direction Sprint.

services.title: Agile, Lean and Product Delivery Transformation
services.headline: Improve delivery flow without losing control
services.body: TORSA helps organisations improve how business and technology teams plan, prioritise and deliver work. Our approach combines SAFe, Agile, Lean Portfolio Management and product-delivery practices with governance that works in the real world.
whatWeDo: Lean Portfolio Management and value-stream design
ART formation and PI Planning support
Product ownership, backlog management and prioritization
Built-In Quality, DevOps and continual-improvement practices
services.outcome: Better alignment between strategy and delivery, improved predictability, faster learning and stronger product and programme outcomes.
services.cta: Contact Us to accelerate your Agile and delivery transformation.

services.title: Information Security and ISO 27001
services.headline: Build trust through stronger information security
services.body: Information security is a business responsibility. TORSA helps organisations establish practical security governance, reduce risk and prepare for ISO 27001:2022 certification or client assurance requirements.
services.supportingBody: Our approach connects security controls to real operational processes, leadership accountability and measurable business resilience.
whatWeDo: ISMS frameworks, policies and control design
Security architecture and Microsoft 365 security baselines
Business continuity, backup, recovery and information-protection governance
services.outcome: A practical, evidence-based security framework that improves resilience, strengthens client confidence and supports certification readiness.
services.cta: Contact Us to request an information-security or ISO 27001 readiness assessment.

services.title: Enterprise Technology and Service Management
services.headline: Create a technology environment that performs reliably
services.body: TORSA helps organisations establish, strengthen and scale the technology foundations that keep the business running. We combine architecture, service-management and delivery expertise to improve operational control and user experience.
whatWeDo: Incident, change, problem and asset-management design
Cloud, digital workplace and Microsoft 365 transformation advisory
Application, infrastructure, data and integration architecture
Technology vendor selection and RFP/RFI support
services.outcome: More reliable services, clearer ownership, improved operational visibility and technology operations that support rather than slow down the business.
services.cta: Contact Us to assess your technology-service maturity.

services.title: Fractional CIO and Technology Leadership Partner
services.headline: Senior technology leadership when you need it
services.body: Not every organisation needs or is ready for a full-time CIO or CTO. TORSA provides experienced, flexible technology leadership for executives, boards and management teams that need strategic guidance and stronger technology oversight.
services.supportingBody: We become a trusted leadership partner, helping you make sound technology decisions while strengthening internal capability.
whatWeDo: Interim CIO, CTO or technology-director support
services.outcome: Confident executive decision-making, stronger technology governance and access to experienced leadership without the overhead of a permanent executive appointment.
services.cta: Contact Us to discuss a flexible technology leadership retainer.

services.title: Bespoke Software and Digital Solution Development
services.headline: Build the solution your business actually needs
services.body: When off-the-shelf systems cannot address a critical business need, TORSA brings together business advisory, solution architecture and an experienced development team to create practical digital solutions.
services.supportingBody: We work from problem definition through design, development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
whatWeDo: Custom web, mobile and enterprise application development
Business portals, intranets and self-service platforms
Integration solutions, APIs and data exchange
SaaS product development and multi-client platforms
Quality assurance, testing, deployment and support

services.cta: Contact Us to talk to us about your next digital solution.

services.title: Strategic Technology Partnerships and Managed Delivery
services.headline: Coordinate the right expertise for complex outcomes
services.body: TORSA leads integrated delivery where clients need strategic advisory, specialist technology capability and implementation assurance. We work with selected partners while retaining accountability for alignment, governance and delivery quality.
whatWeDo: Cloud, security, ERP, CRM, analytics and digital-workplace delivery through qualified partners
TORSA-led delivery governance and executive reporting

services.cta: Contact Us to discuss your technology implementation requirements.

services.headline: Build practical capability that lasts
services.body: TORSA delivers targeted learning for leaders, technology professionals and delivery teams. Our programmes focus on real-world application, not theory alone, giving participants tools they can use immediately.

services.cta: Contact Us to start your AI readiness assessment.

Agile coaches, Scrum Masters and SAFe practitioners
IT service management and service delivery

dimenserve.title: DimenServe GRC Platform
dimenserve.headline: Digitize governance, risk and compliance
dimenserve.intro: DimenServe is an enterprise-ready Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) platform designed to simplify governance, assurance, and continuous improvement without the cost and complexity of large enterprise suites.
dimenserve.description: It provides a configurable digital environment for organizations that want to replace fragmented spreadsheets, emails and manual processes with traceable, accountable governance workflows. Primarily, the platform brings risk, compliance, audit, action management and continual improvement into one configurable digital ecosystem.
solution: DimenServe GRC platform implementation and managed configuration
Compliance, risk, audit and corrective-action workflow automation
GRC reporting, executive dashboards and evidence-management solutions
capabilities: Risk, compliance, audit and corrective-action management
ISO and integrated management-system workflow digitization
Policy, control, evidence and obligation management
Continual improvement, task and action tracking
Audit planning, findings, remediation and management reporting
Role-based access, segregation of duties and end-to-end traceability
Platform configuration, implementation, integration and user adoption support
dimenserve.bestFor: Organizations managing risk, audits, controls and evidence through fragmented manual processes
valueRealization: Greater visibility, clearer ownership, easier audit preparation and reliable traceability from risk and control to evidence and action.
Move beyond disconnected spreadsheets and manual follow-ups with configurable workflows, evidence management, dashboards and clear ownership.
Designed for ISO, risk, audit, and governance-driven organizations

serviceOffering.title: Flexible GRC Delivery Models
serviceOffering.intro: DimenServe GRC is TORSA Consulting’s proprietary platform for managing governance, risk, compliance, audit, actions and continual improvement in one connected environment.
serviceOffering.description: Organisations have different levels of internal GRC capability, capacity and maturity. TORSA therefore offers three flexible service models, allowing clients to select the level of platform access, specialist support and assurance that best suits their needs.

models.name: DimenServe GRC Platform Subscription
models.tagline: Your platform. Your processes. Your control.
models.description: This model is designed for organisations that have their own GRC, risk, compliance, quality or internal-audit capability and want a configurable platform to manage their processes more effectively.
torsaProvides: Configuration of agreed modules, workflows and user roles
Technical support, maintenance and platform enhancements
models.bestSuitedTo: Organisations with established internal GRC capability that want to digitize manual processes, improve traceability and gain better management visibility.

models.name: Managed GRC Service with DimenServe
models.tagline: Your GRC function, managed by TORSA.
models.description: This model is designed for organisations that want to outsource all or part of their GRC function to TORSA. TORSA uses DimenServe GRC as the operating platform to manage agreed governance, risk, compliance and continual-improvement activities on the client’s behalf.
torsaProvides: DimenServe GRC platform subscription and administration
Policy, control, evidence and obligation management
Internal-audit planning, coordination and delivery support
clientManages: Executive accountability for governance, risk and compliance
Approval of policies, risk appetite and key decisions
Control ownership and operational evidence provision
models.bestSuitedTo: Organisations that need an outsourced GRC capability, additional specialist capacity, stronger governance discipline or a practical route to ISO and other assurance readiness.

models.name: DimenServe GRC Platform with Internal Audit Services
models.tagline: Your GRC function. Independent assurance from TORSA.
models.description: This model is designed for organisations that want to own and manage their GRC processes internally while using DimenServe GRC as their digital platform. TORSA provides independent internal-audit services to assess the effectiveness of governance, risk, compliance and control arrangements.
torsaProvides: Platform implementation, configuration and user training
Internal-audit planning and annual audit program development
Audit findings, recommendations and corrective-action tracking
Audit reporting for management and governance structures
Optional GRC advisory, provided outside the audit scope to preserve independence
clientManages: Responses to audit findings and remediation plans
models.bestSuitedTo: Organisations with internal GRC ownership that require a structured platform and independent, experienced internal-audit capability.

scalablePartnership.title: A Scalable Partnership
scalablePartnership.body: Clients can begin with one model and evolve as their needs change. For example, an organization may start with a platform subscription, engage TORSA for internal audits as governance maturity grows, or move to a managed GRC service during periods of transition, growth or limited internal capacity.
scalablePartnership.nextStep: TORSA will work with each client to define the appropriate platform modules, service scope, governance model, implementation approach and support arrangement.

atAGlance.bestFor: Organisations with established internal GRC capability
Organisations outsourcing all or part of their GRC function
